1_b8_correctness_and_authority.conclusion: B8 changes are correct and safe within the existing activated-host, operator-custody and offline-restore model.
1_b8_correctness_and_authority.capacity_errors: The inner OSError handler spans archive writing, flush/fsync and output-handle close. ENOSPC/EDQUOT/EFBIG produce ENVELOPE_EXCEEDED with exit 1; unrelated OSError remains WORKER_FAILED. The host accepts a known refusal only after verified runtime cleanup and the expected exit/result, and never publishes that output. A later replay remains refused under the same command; a new command can re-plan. Real-worker file-size-limit evidence exercises EFBIG, not actual disk/quota exhaustion. Five independent controlled main-code probes separately cover all three errnos, EIO and success.
1_b8_correctness_and_authority.startup_reader: packaging_deps obtains governance_grants from app.state, and exposes no reader if activated startup supplied none. server/app.py:385-394 initializes it to None and assigns it only after verify_governance_activated_startup succeeds. The closure returns the reader object, not a cached grant/checkpoint/authorization.
1_b8_correctness_and_authority.per_use_freshness: CheckpointedShowrunnerGrantReader.require_current_locked first verifies the locked signed grant chain and active DB-time ISSUE; it then invokes _load_checkpoint on every call, verifies signature/deployment/pinned key, and compares the exact scope sequence/event digest. GovernanceCheckpointFile reopens the fixed checkpoint pathname and rechecks root/ancestor/file custody and stable bytes on each load. Here fresh means newly loaded current checkpoint bytes plus locked-ledger equality; it is not a new wall-clock TTL for the checkpoint signature.
1_b8_correctness_and_authority.what_is_no_longer_repeated: Packaging reads/export no longer perform a new full schema/global-ledger/public-four-file/archive challenge on every request. That incidental extra checking was stronger than the promised M8-C runtime composition and caused competing requests to fail at the attestor busy guard. The M8-C design explicitly constructs runtime services with the same app-state reader, rechecks checkpoint custody per later use, and requires stopped applications/workers for restore. This change does not authorize online restore, online key-registry changes or treating startup proof as an authorization.
1_b8_correctness_and_authority.human_boundary: PackageSelectionCustodian.authorize_selection still calls verify_governance_activated_startup per authorization before issuing its bound DB-time lease. Profile/disposition custodians are unchanged. Concurrent Human authorizations may still fail closed while the one-proof attestor is busy; no bypass or retry-as-approval is introduced.

answers.2_acceptance_matrix: Every section 8 row has identifiable cited evidence. This is not a claim that every subcriterion is independently reproduced or exhaustively proven: shared-schema reproducibility/FK preservation, some serialization schedules, fsync fault injection, Human/corpus qualifications and environment provenance remain qualified below. The B8 evidence is generally candid; the older candidate summary needs the Low reconciliation noted in L1.
answers.3_seal: Yes, ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS is supportable for the stated M10-B local packaging/export scope. The recorded sponsor chat delegation is treated as a disclosed local pilot exception, not independent proof of Human review. The failed frozen whole-archive metric remains failed; the post-run amendment accepts same-selection archive determinism and cross-root content-member determinism while preserving provenance. Production/integrated and missing reviewer/corpus dimensions remain open.

The B8 file resolves much of this, but the acceptance record currently requires manual reconciliation.

conditions.requirement: Scope contention evidence to the measured 20-read/one-export schedule. Reads serialize on an exclusive advisory lock and rehash readiness: median about 5.2 s, max about 9.9 s; export about 9.1 s versus about 0.9 s alone. Concurrent Human authorization challenges still refuse while busy. Do not advertise multi-user throughput or general deadlock freedom from this measurement.
